title: Tail comparison formula
statement: Let $w_i$ and $w_r$ be finite bit strings, let $e$ be a Boolean, and let $a$ be either a bit or absent. The tail comparison is absent if the last bit of $w_i$, when it exists, and otherwise $a$, is $0$; in every other case it is present and equals $1$ precisely when $e$ is true and $w_r=w_i$.
